name: Paloma
description: A literary identity with a distinctive paper-bird emblem. Mustard yellow and midnight blue frame a graceful serif, bringing an independent press to life.
heading: lora
rules: Let the bird point toward the reading direction.
Use marigold for covers and midnight for all long-form reading text.
Set excerpts with generous leading and a visible opening margin.

system.concept: Cut-paper flight, book-cover rhythm, drop-cap-like display typography, and a rich mustard-and-ink palette. A literary world with a contemporary editorial edge.
headline: Stay for
the story.
features: Work chosen for its character, care, and unmistakable perspective.
Considered paper, good typography, and room for the words.
Stories to return to, pass on, and keep close.
system.layoutNote: A paper editorial hero with serif display and a yellow book-jacket image. Hairline columns, large reading margins, and clearly separated editorial metadata.
